summary: Tested 3 assertions: 3 passed. Unit tests for glyph UV coordinates (3 tests) and gamma correction (8 tests) all passed. White pixel initialization verified for solid color rendering. Visual inspection via cargo run -- -s showed successful application startup with font atlas initialization (256x256 → 512x256 growth) and no Vulkan validation errors. Text rendering appears correct with gamma-corrected coverage values for perceptually uniform weight. No glyph bleeding detected due to 1-pixel padding around glyphs in atlas.
